thread:
ben: quick PSA — infra rotated a batch of shortlinks last night, and I hit a 404 in a curl sample while following the runbook. did a quick scan and found a handful across runbooks, kb, and a runtime guide.
claire: ugh thanks. can you drop the list?
ben: pasted full list here: https://paste.redwood.example/rotations/yz123 (runbooks/oncall.md, kb/troubleshooting.md, runtime/kv-cache.md, plus 2 handbook snippets)
emma: I can take oncall + handbook. small sed replace should cover it.
ben: heads-up: some matches are inside sample outputs (do not change). I filtered with `rg "curl .*short\.rwd" -n docs/` then eyeballed.
claire: pro tip: `rg -n "short\.rwd" docs/ | while read l; do awk "NR>=(\$(echo $l | cut -d: -f2)-3) && NR<=(\$(echo $l | cut -d: -f2)+3)" $(echo $l | cut -d: -f1); done` to inspect context quickly.
docs-bot: Reminder: small doc patches require a changelog entry, CODEOWNERS mention, and passing docs build.
ops-bot: Ticket created: DOCS-3988 "Shortlink rotation - replace curl examples" (links to PRs after opened).
emma: PR created for oncall+handbook: https://git.redwood.example/repo/docs/pull/1024 — changelog added, CODEOWNERS @docs-maintainers.
claire: will open runtime+kb PR after stand. I want to run `npm run docs:build` and local link-checker first.
ben: if anyone sees short.rwd in `docs/devex/` it's safe to leave a note instead of editing (those are intentionally preserved examples).
claire: noted. planning a 15-min sweep at 2pm to catch leftovers. ping me if you want ownership of specific files.
ben: thanks all — merging plan: wait for CI, then run site smoke check and close DOCS-3988. :white_check_mark:
